entities.name: LandingGatesInfra
observations: Bootstrapped Doxa's standard landing-gate infrastructure into doxa-mcp-schema (2026-08-11): KG Guard + Claude Code Review CI workflows, kg-save/review/test PreToolUse hooks, attest-review.sh, knowledge-graph-merkle.js + ontology-guard.js + kg-index.js, .claude/settings.json hook wiring. Ported from openclaw's working reference implementation per doxa-cns CLAUDE.md PR-visibility / bank-the-gold / kg-save-on-every-merge doctrine. test-gate.sh code_re scoped to server/src + server/scripts + clients/typescript/src (schemas/examples/docs excluded — this repo is mostly schema+docs). NOTE: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret not yet configured on GitHub for this repo — review workflow is inert until Garth adds it.

entities.name: KgMerkleFixesPropagated
observations: Propagated the 2026-08-11 atomic-write and --type-guard fixes from doxa-cns's canonical knowledge-graph-merkle.js.

entities.name: KgMergeIntegrityGuard
observations: New standing gate (2026-08-13, Garth: 'standing doctrine and practice across all repos'): merge-resolve CLI command unions both sides of a .knowledge-graph-merkle.json conflict by observation hash instead of picking one (the observations array is an append log; checkout --ours/--theirs always drops data). check-kg-merge-integrity.js is the mechanical detector wired into kg-save-gate.sh: for any merge commit in the landing range, if the result is missing an observation hash present in a parent, the landing is blocked and the specific dropped entity is named. Ported from doxa-cns's canonical version, built and verified against the real incident that motivated it (PR #343's KgAddTrailingTypeFlagFix entity, silently dropped by checkout --theirs).
